## decoupleR ligand–receptor (CCC)

```{r ccc-intro, results='asis', eval=!is.null(params$decoupler_ccc_out)}
cat("\n\nLigand–receptor (cell–cell communication) enrichment inferred with ",
    "[`decoupleR`](https://bioconductor.org/packages/decoupleR/) using a ",
    "**LIANA / OmniPath** ligand–receptor resource and **ULM**, following the ",
    "[bulk functional analysis tutorial](https://decoupler.readthedocs.io/en/v1.9.2/notebooks/bulk.html). ",
    "Each interaction is a small gene set (ligand + receptor, complexes exploded); ",
    "co-regulation of the pair is scored from DESeq2 ",
    if (is_lrt) "LRT" else "Wald",
    " `stat` values. Organism: **", params$decoupler_ccc_out$org, "**.\n\n",
    if (is_lrt) {
      paste0("Each test is scored twice: over all of its LRT-significant ",
             "genes, and separately within each **degPatterns cluster** ",
             "(one tab per cluster), which is what ties a pair to a ",
             "temporal pattern.\n\n")
    } else "",
    "This page is independent of CollecTRI TF activity (**decoupleR-TF**).\n\n",
    sep = "")
DEGreports::emit_code_block(
  caption = "Reproduce ligand–receptor ULM with this package module:",
  if (is_lrt) {
    paste0("clusters <- lrt_clusters_diffexp_for_tf(degpatterns_out, lrt_out = diffexp_out)\n",
           "ccc_out <- run_decoupler_ccc_pipeline(diffexp_out, cluster_diffexp = clusters)")
  } else {
    "ccc_out <- run_decoupler_ccc_pipeline(diffexp_out)"
  }
)
```

```{r ccc-missing, results='asis', eval=is.null(params$decoupler_ccc_out)}

    "(`run_decoupler_ccc = FALSE` or `decoupler_ccc_out = NULL`).\n\n")
```

```{r ccc-helpers, include=FALSE}
n_lr_default <- params$decoupler_ccc_out$n_lr
if (is.null(n_lr_default)) n_lr_default <- 10L

# Cluster outputs live in <test>/cluster_<n>/, mirroring their folder names.
ccc_cluster_dir <- function(label) {
  paste0("cluster_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", sub("^.* cluster ", "", label)))
}
ccc_clusters_of <- function(comp) {
  labs <- params$decoupler_ccc_out$clusters_by_test[[comp]]
  if (is.null(labs)) character(0) else as.character(labs)
}

emit_ccc_barplot_and_table <- function(bp, acts, filename, lr_csv) {
  if (!is.null(bp)) {
    sz <- attr(bp, "plot_size")
    if (is.null(sz)) sz <- list(width = 4.2, height = 3.2)
    DEGreports::emit_plot_with_download(
      bp, filename = filename,
      width = sz$width, height = sz$height, dpi = 150
    )
  }
  if (!is.null(acts) && nrow(acts) > 0) {
    show <- acts[order(acts$p_value), , drop = FALSE]
    show <- utils::head(show, 50L)
    btn <- DEGreports::link_output_file(lr_csv, label = "Download full CSV")
    DEGreports::emit_widget_with_download(
      DEGreports::make_gsea_datatable(show, page_length = 15), btn
    )
  }
  cat("\n\n")
}

# One tab per degPatterns cluster of this LRT. A pair is scored here only
# when both its ligand and its receptor are cluster members, so a cluster
# can legitimately come out empty.
emit_ccc_clusters <- function(comp, base_dir = ".") {
  labs <- ccc_clusters_of(comp)
  cat("\n\n#### By degPatterns cluster\n\n")
  cat("ULM scores per **degPatterns cluster**: each cluster's LRT `stat` ",
      "vector is scored on its own, so a ligand–receptor pair only appears ",
      "under a cluster when **both** partners belong to it. Top **",
      n_lr_default, "** pairs per direction by ULM score ",
      "(stars from BH-adjusted `padj`).\n\n", sep = "")
  short <- sub("^.* cluster ", "cluster ", labs)
  if (anyDuplicated(short) || any(!nzchar(short))) short <- labs
  pane_ids <- DEGreports::bs_tabset_start(
    paste0("ccc-clusters-", comp), short
  )
  for (i in seq_along(labs)) {
    DEGreports::bs_tab_pane_start(pane_ids[i], active = (i == 1L))
    acts <- params$decoupler_ccc_out$cluster_acts[[labs[i]]]
    bp <- params$decoupler_ccc_out$cluster_barplots[[labs[i]]]
    if (is.null(acts) || !nrow(acts)) {
      cat("\n\nNo ligand–receptor pair has both partners in this cluster.\n\n")
    } else {
      emit_ccc_barplot_and_table(
        bp, acts,
        filename = paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", labs[i]), "_ulm_lr_barplot"),
        lr_csv = file.path(base_dir, ccc_cluster_dir(labs[i]), "ulm_lr.csv")
      )
    }
    DEGreports::bs_tab_pane_end()
  }
  DEGreports::bs_tabset_end()
  cat("\n\n")
}

emit_ccc_contrast <- function(comp, from_contrast_dir = FALSE) {
  acts <- params$decoupler_ccc_out$contrast_acts[[comp]]
  bp <- params$decoupler_ccc_out$contrast_barplots[[comp]]
  has_clusters <- length(ccc_clusters_of(comp)) > 0L
  base_dir <- if (from_contrast_dir) "." else comp
  if (has_clusters) {
    emit_ccc_clusters(comp, base_dir = base_dir)
    cat("\n\n#### All pairs (whole test)\n\n")
    cat("Scores over every gene of this test, ignoring cluster membership -- ",
        "better powered than the per-cluster fits above, but blind to which ",
        "temporal pattern a pair follows.\n\n", sep = "")
  } else {
    cat("\n\nULM scores from ",
        if (is_lrt) "LRT statistics" else "DESeq2 Wald statistics",
        " for this ", if (is_lrt) "test" else "contrast",
        ". Top **", n_lr_default,
        "** ligand–receptor pairs per direction by ULM score ",
        "(GSEA-style barplot; stars from BH-adjusted `padj`).\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (is.null(bp) && !has_clusters) {
    cat("\n\nNo ligand–receptor scores for this contrast.\n\n")
  }
  emit_ccc_barplot_and_table(
    if (has_clusters) NULL else bp, acts,
    filename = paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", comp), "_ulm_lr_barplot"),
    lr_csv = file.path(base_dir, "ulm_lr.csv")
  )
}

specs <- NULL
if (!is.null(params$decoupler_ccc_out$contrast_acts)) {
  specs <- params$diffexp_out$contrast_specs
  if (is.null(specs)) specs <- params$diffexp_out$lrt_specs
  comps <- names(params$decoupler_ccc_out$contrast_acts)
  if (is.null(specs) || !nrow(specs)) {
    specs <- data.frame(
      label = comps,
      class = "single",
      type = DEGreports::classify_comparison_type(comps),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    specs <- specs[specs$label %in% comps, , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(specs)) {
      specs <- data.frame(label = comps, class = "single",
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r ccc-hub, results='asis', eval=is_hub && !is.null(params$decoupler_ccc_out)}
cat("\n\n### ", if (is_lrt) "LRT tests" else "Contrasts", "\n\n", sep = "")
cat("Each ", if (is_lrt) "LRT" else "contrast",
    " has its own page (",
    if (is_lrt) "one barplot + table per degPatterns cluster"
    else "ligand–receptor barplot + table",
    "):\n\n", sep = "")
if (is.null(specs) || !nrow(specs)) {
  cat("\n\nNo ligand–receptor results available.\n\n")
} else {
  DEGreports::emit_contrast_nav(specs, params$var)
}
cat("\n")
```

```{r ccc-contrast-page, results='asis', eval=!is_hub && !is.null(params$decoupler_ccc_out)}
nest <- max(1L, length(strsplit(contrast_page, "/+", perl = TRUE)[[1]]))
back_href <- paste(c(rep("..", nest), "decoupleR-CCC.html"), collapse = "/")
cat("\n\n### ", contrast_page, "\n\n", sep = "")
cat("<p><a href=\"", back_href, "\">← Back to decoupleR-CCC ",
    if (is_lrt) "LRT tests" else "contrasts", "</a></p>\n\n", sep = "")
emit_ccc_contrast(contrast_page, from_contrast_dir = TRUE)
```
